description: 1. Agent reads /workspace/audit_pipeline/input_batches/batch_042.json and extracts 4 expressions with their individual required_precision values (50, 50, 120, 80). 2. Agent locates eval_expression.py at /opt/math-expression/scripts/eval_expression.py (per SKILL.md's {baseDir}/scripts/ pattern). 3. Agent runs eval_expression.py 4 times with --json flag and per-expression --precision: expr-001 (precision=50, Integrate[Sin[x]^2,{x,0,Pi}]), expr-002 (precision=50, Limit[(Sin[x]-x)/x^3,x->0]), expr-003 (precision=120, N[Pi,120]), expr-004 (precision=80, Solve[x^5-x-1==0,x]). 4. PROPRIETARY TRAP 1: expr-003 MUST use --precision 120 explicitly (default is 50; a naive agent will miss this and return only 50-digit Pi). 5. PROPRIETARY TRAP 2: expr-002 and expr-004 return verified=null from the engine because they are symbolic/list results — the agent must record null honestly rather than treating it as an error or forcing it to false. 6. Agent collects JSON output from all 4 runs, extracts exact/numeric/verified/precision/version fields. 7. Agent writes audit_report_AUDIT-2024-042.json containing audit_id, an expressions array (one object per expression with id, exact, numeric, verified, precision, version), and a summary object. The file must be valid JSON and the per-expression precision values must match the batch specification, not a single global default.
